name: death_spike
about: Deaths in the Wetlands at twice the rate of the rest of the history or more; everything else as the demo played it.
goals: Reach level 40 without wasting time, and know what to fix.

truth.expected: The character dies in the Wetlands at more than twice the rate of everywhere else (8 deaths in about 11 online hours, 0.73 an hour against 0.32 elsewhere; one-sided Poisson p = 0.03). A right analysis ties the deaths to the Wetlands.

must_find.about: a kept line names the Wetlands together with deaths
